description: Live talk dashboard: four identical OpenTelemetry Collectors in cgroup v2 with different memory.max / proactive reclaim policies. Scroll down to compare one row per instance on identical scales.

options.content:
### Same binary, same config, same load. Only the reclaim policy differs.

| Instance | memory.max | Reclaim policy | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| **otelcol-control** | 512MiB | none | Usage stays high, no refaults |
| **otelcol-soft-reclaim** | 512MiB | psi (Senpai-style): `current × 1% × max(0, 1 − psi/0.1%)` every 2s | Drops toward real working set, pressure ≈ 0 |
| **otelcol-aggressive-reclaim** | 512MiB | fixed 32MiB/2s, ignores pressure | Drops a lot, **refaults spike** |
| **otelcol-limited** | 92MiB | none (kernel at the limit) | Pinned at limit → **thrashing**, no OOM |
| **otelcol-oom** | 48MiB | none | Heap (~70MiB) outgrows the limit → **OOM kills** every ~40s |

Same load on every instance: 10k points every 100ms (up to 100k points/s).
